name: BlueCross BlueShield of South Carolina
appeal_notes: Submit provider reconsideration through My Insurance Manager (MIM); attach medical records and the remittance advice.

name: BlueChoice HealthPlan of South Carolina
appeal_notes: Reconsiderations filed electronically via MIM; second-level appeal in writing to the Provider Appeals Unit.

name: UnitedHealthcare
portal_name: UHC Provider Portal (UnitedHealthcare Provider Portal / Optum Pay)
appeal_notes: Electronic reconsideration/appeal submission is required for most plans; use Claims & Payments > Claim Reconsideration in the provider portal. Standard filing window is 12 months (365 days) from the original remittance date.

name: Aetna
appeal_notes: Level 1 reconsideration within 180 days of the remittance; submit via Availity Disputes & Appeals with clinical documentation.

name: Cigna Healthcare
appeal_notes: Submit appeals through CignaforHCP or Availity; include the appeal request form and supporting medical records.

name: Humana
appeal_notes: Medicare Advantage reconsiderations within 60 days of the remittance; commercial disputes within 90 days.

name: Medicare (Palmetto GBA, JM MAC)
appeal_notes: First level = redetermination, filed within 120 days of the initial determination (MSN/RA date). eServices supports electronic submission with attachments.

name: South Carolina Medicaid (Healthy Connections / SCDHHS)
portal_name: SCDHHS Medicaid Web-based Claims Submission Tool
appeal_notes: Appeal must be filed within 30 days of the notice; the Division of Appeals and Hearings accepts electronic and mailed submissions.

name: Absolute Total Care (Centene)
portal_name: Absolute Total Care Secure Provider Portal
appeal_notes: Claim disputes within 90 days of the EOP; submit through the secure provider portal with supporting documentation.

name: Molina Healthcare of South Carolina
appeal_notes: Provider claim appeal/dispute form submitted via the provider portal within 90 days of the remittance advice.

name: TRICARE East (Humana Military)
appeal_notes: Appeals must be filed within 90 days of the date of the EOB; submit online through provider self-service.

name: Ambetter from Absolute Total Care
appeal_notes: Reconsideration then formal appeal; both accepted through the secure provider portal.
